mapper.select: SELECT id,warehouse_code code,warehouse_name name FROM bike_warehouse WHERE status='ENABLED' ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_warehouse WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ENABLED'
SELECT document_snapshot FROM bike_pi WHERE id=#{piId}
SELECT current_warehouse_id FROM bike_vehicle WHERE id=#{vehicleId}
SELECT sku_id FROM bike_production_vehicle WHERE vehicle_id=#{vehicleId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(i.ordered_qty-i.shipped_qty-i.closed_qty,0)),0) FROM bike_order_reservation_item i JOIN bike_order_reservation r ON r.order_id=i.order_id JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=r.order_id JOIN bike_pi_order_link link ON link.order_id=o.id JOIN bike_pi_series series ON series.id=link.series_id JOIN bike_pi p ON p.id=series.current_pi_id WHERE i.sku_id=#{skuId} AND r.hold_mode='PAID' AND o.status IN ('CONFIRMED','PARTIAL_SHIPPED') AND series.id!=#{excludedSeriesId} AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.document_snapshot,'$.business.warehouseId')) AS UNSIGNED)=#{warehouseId}
SELECT id FROM bike_inventory_lock WHERE lock_no=#{lockNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_order_reservation(order_id,source_lock_id,request_id,model_id,reserved_qty,expires_at,scope_type,hold_mode,payment_hold_pi_id,payment_held_at,payment_held_by,payment_held_amount) SELECT #{orderId},l.id,CONCAT('PI_PAID_',#{piId},'_',#{orderId}),l.product_model_id,l.lock_qty,NOW(3),'SKU','PAID',#{piId},NOW(3),#{operatorId}, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay.amount),0) FROM bike_pi_payment pay JOIN bike_pi origin ON origin.id=pay.pi_id JOIN bike_pi current_pi ON current_pi.series_id=origin.series_id WHERE current_pi.id=#{piId} AND pay.status='CONFIRMED') FROM bike_inventory_lock l WHERE l.id=#{lockId}
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_order_reservation SET hold_mode='PAID',payment_hold_pi_id=#{piId},payment_held_at=NOW(3),payment_held_by=#{operatorId},released_at=NULL WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND hold_mode IN ('TIMED','PAID')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_pi_payment payment JOIN bike_pi origin ON origin.id=payment.pi_id JOIN bike_pi current_pi ON current_pi.series_id=origin.series_id WHERE current_pi.id=#{piId} AND payment.status='CONFIRMED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_payment_attachment attachment WHERE attachment.payment_id=payment.id)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(item.ordered_qty-(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_stock_out_record so JOIN bike_pi_order_link link ON link.order_id=so.order_id JOIN bike_production_vehicle pv ON pv.vehicle_id=so.vehicle_id WHERE link.series_id=p.series_id AND so.status='COMPLETED' AND pv.sku_id=item.sku_id),0)),0) FROM bike_pi p JOIN bike_pi_item item ON item.pi_id=p.id WHERE p.id=#{piId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_pi p JOIN bike_pi_order_link link ON link.series_id=p.series_id JOIN bike_stock_out_record so ON so.order_id=link.order_id AND so.status='COMPLETED' WHERE p.id=#{piId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_stock_out_batch batch JOIN bike_pi p ON p.series_id=batch.series_id WHERE p.id=#{piId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_stock_out_batch_item bi JOIN bike_stock_out_record so ON so.id=bi.stock_out_id AND so.status='COMPLETED' WHERE bi.batch_id=batch.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_logistics l WHERE l.stock_out_batch_id=batch.id AND l.status='SHIPPED')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_pi_logistics_attachment a JOIN bike_pi_logistics l ON l.id=a.logistics_id JOIN bike_pi origin ON origin.id=l.pi_id JOIN bike_pi current_pi ON current_pi.series_id=origin.series_id WHERE current_pi.id=#{piId} AND a.id=#{attachmentId} AND l.status IN ('PLANNED','SHIPPED')
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_pi_workflow_step step JOIN bike_pi_series series ON series.current_pi_id=step.pi_id JOIN bike_pi origin ON origin.series_id=series.id SET step.status='PENDING',step.completed_by=NULL,step.completed_at=NULL WHERE origin.id=#{piId} AND step.step_code IN ('WAREHOUSE_ARRIVED','TRACKING_RECORDED','CUSTOMER_RECEIVED')
